lines: Astaroth's Hellfire bared its blazing fangs as it attacked Flame King.
Undaunted by that, he neutralized it by spraying a huge amount of water, then swung his fist towards her.
This was simply a battle between the powers of her fire and his hosing.
「You're quite good! How about this, then?!」
Astaroth called forth even greater Hellfire.
The Hellfire that she wielded was summoned from the land of blazing heat in the Demon World.
As long as that land existed, those flames would never die, and would obey her as her servants.
Flame King gleefully pointed his hose nozzle at them.
「You can't put out my Hellfire merely by spraying water on it♪」
The water that he sprayed took the shape of a shield, blocking and extinguishing Astaroth's flames.
「I'm surprised......♪ To put out my Hellfire with mere water♪」
「My passion will extinguish any flame! ......is what I'd like to say, but this is no ordinary water!」
「It's a powerful firefighting liquid, for which I captured the queen of the water nymphs, who reside further below Yomihara, and mixed her tears into it!」
「I've been keeping up some pretty intense torture to make her carry on shedding tears, but this, too, is for the sake of preventing disaster in Yomihara!」
「No matter what cruel means are used, I will always! Put! Out! The fire! That's me! Flame King!!!!!!」
「All right, let's have a duel. If you win, I'll give you the right to propose to me.」
Astaroth's hand became charged with unprecedented heat.
「I don't want anything like that, but if you burn it, I'll put it out!!」
At the same time, Flame King charged up his firefighting fluid even further. They were about to literally open fire, for the ultimate showdown.
Suddenly, some out-of-place flower petals fluttered around them.
「Ahhh. This is worse than I thought.」
The one who showed herself was the Taimanin woman Astaroth had seen in the plaza.
――And the armed refugee brothers, who had disappeared at some point, were there too.
「Your target...... Umm, what was it again? Anyhow, I'll burn it to your heart's content♪」
Having gotten to meet a strong person, Astaroth was in a good mood, and therefore didn't care that the pair of them had run away right in the middle.
「Th-That's the thing. We'd like you to stop now......」
「We did say we'd destroy Yomihara, but to be honest, we didn't really feel like it was gonna happen. I mean......」
「We just thought we could scare them by starting a small fire.」
Having gotten scared of Astaroth's power, the brothers had gone to ask help from Shizuru, the Taimanin they had spotted on the way.
Figuring that a Taimanin, who had power that rivalled a demon's, might possibly be able to stop her.
However, seeing that Taimanin, she instead formed a combative smile.
「You're one of those people they call Taimanin, yes? I'm not into women, but if you're strong, that's a different story♪」
「Sorry to disappoint you, but I haven't come for a fight.」
「Just to stop you, and minimize the damage.」
Shizuru was unemotional towards Astaroth, who seemed to be provoking her.
「A Taimanin, huh?! I beg your help! Hold this woman back for me. In the meantime, I'll extinguish her fire with all the water I've......」
However, she also admonished Flame King, in the exact same manner as if she were scolding her student.
「I can't overlook you tormenting that water nymph queen any longer.」
「What the?! Before the righteousness of firefighting, a little sacrifice is......」
「It's not a little! If the queen of the water nymphs dies, the source of Yomihara's water will dry up.」
「Once that happens, Yomihara will be devastated, and you, of course, will be kicked off the fire brigade. Even Flame King will probably be scrapped.」
Calmly, but surely, Shizuru hit him where it hurt, and made him face reality.
Flame King flinched at her, and fell to his knees on the floor.
On the other hand, seeing him like that, Astaroth also appeared to have lost her enthusiasm.
「That's more or less killed my mood. I thought you were a strong opponent, but to think you'd falter just from being lectured...」
「P-Please wait! We'll change the location and have a rematch......!!!」
Astaroth called out to nowhere in particular, at which point flames flared up, and an image of Vesta appeared within them.
Vesta made a quizzical face for a moment, but these whims were typical of her mistress.
『As you wish. I expect the human world is dusty. Allow me to prepare your bath.』
Astaroth said, and vanished, enveloped in flames.
However, the fire simply burned bright red, with no further reply.
The fire had been safely put out by Flame King, and the damage had been limited to part of the Greed House.
The inhabitants of Yomihara went about their lives, unaware that this disturbance had even happened.
「Ummm, thank you very much for stopping me.」
「I lose my senses when there's a fire in front of me......」
The New Outer Flood Bypass, the gateway connecting Yomihara to the surface.
Flame King was making his huge frame bow apologetically in front of Shizuru.
「Like a fighting bull, eh? A fire in Yomihara is a serious matter, to be sure. But from now on, think about something other than firefighting, all right?」
At that moment, his eyes lit up, and a siren rang out. It was the signal of an emergency transmission.

「Yes, this is Flame King!!
――What? A fire's broken out in the slums? The cause is a barbecue in an alley?」
「Dammit, you paupers! After I put out the fire, I'll purge the poor, in the name of disaster prevention!!!」
Flame King, who seemed to have received a report of a fire, declared something unsettling as he changed into a fire truck, and headed back while blaring his siren.
「......He hasn't learned his lesson at all, has he?」
One was supposed to have to go through complex tunnels to get from here to Yomihara, yet Flame King would probably even bulldoze his way through those to come rushing to the scene.
「Well, it feels like it'll make things more complicated if I poke my nose in any further――Now, shall I head home too?」
「......I have to report about that demon woman as well, anyway.」
With the siren fading into the distance behind her, Shizuru began walking towards the surface.
